title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and improve build cache hygiene
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: Our monolithic CI workflows have grown slow and brittle as we added matrix jobs for node versions, lint rules, and release automation. This PR splits lint, test, and release automation into focused workflows, improves cache keys and restore/save logic, and applies a few hygiene fixes to reduce CI time and flakiness. Summary of changes: consolidated lint job into a dedicated workflow (lint.yml) that runs on push and PRs with changed-js/ts paths; split test jobs into a smaller per-package test workflow (test.yml) with a more targeted matrix and smarter cache restore; moved release automation (publish/release) to a separate workflow (release.yml) that only triggers for release/* tags or manual dispatch; improved build cache keys to include node-version, lockfile-hash, and package-path to reduce cache misses; removed deprecated actions and upgraded to maintained actions versions; added guard to skip heavy integration matrix on docs-only and tooling-only changes. Checklist: [x] Split workflows into lint/test/release [x] Update cache keys and bump actions [x] Add path filters to avoid unnecessary runs [x] Run full test matrix on nightly only [x] Add descriptive job names and annotations for flakes Changeset: - Added .github/workflows/lint.yml - Added .github/workflows/test.yml - Added .github/workflows/release.yml - Updated .github/actions/cache-utils/action.yml - Small package.json devDep bumps for eslint, jest, turbo Testing: validated locally with act for basic workflow syntax; pushed to branch and verified PR CI run; iterative fixes after lint failures (see commits). Impact: reduces CI bill by avoiding redundant runs, improves feedback loop for lint vs unit test failures, and isolates release automation to fewer events. Related: ENG-1824 (CI debt), ENG-1901 (release automation flaky runs). Notes: Kept a short compatibility shim in the monorepo root to ensure legacy dispatch events still work for a month. Follow-ups: monitor cache hit ratios and adjust keys; consider splitting test.yml further by package in a later change.
